A value eagle-api does not hold is fetched once from the public source (F08 decision 3); gnomAD and VariantValidator share one rate budget in eagle-api (F08 slice 10), and a spent budget is answered "rate limited, retry in N seconds", never as an empty result. The variants a user asks about leave the hospital for gnomAD and VariantValidator when EAGLE does not hold them yet; the companion skill tells the agent to send the variant only. Build-dependent tools take genome_build and name the build they used; since F08 slice 14 they default to the user's genome_build setting (GRCh38 or GRCh37, GRCh38 by default), a preference, never a secret, that sends nothing new. Public, granted to every role (migration 0009). Awaiting human review and the EAGLE team's sign-off.
